brief: A three-storey tower: drawers on the bottom storey and open bins on the top storey.

requirements.evidence: Three stacked half-n bases at (0,0) levels 0,1,2: piece:0,0,0;half-n, piece:0,0,1;half-n, piece:0,0,2;half-n with snaps between storeys. check_build meshClash clear.
Drawer on cut face of bottom half base: drawer:0#0,0#cut at q0,r0,level0 (socket s / key s). No drawer required on upper levels, satisfying bottom-storey location.

requirements.requirement: Open bins on the top storey
requirements.evidence: Open bin on top level half base: bin:0,0,2~hex-bin-half-n-full at level 2. Bin is exposed open tray, not covered.

finish.summary: Built vertical 3-storey tower of half-n bases at 0,0 (levels 0-2). Bottom storey hosts a drawer on its south cut face; top storey hosts an open full bin (hex-bin-half-n-full). Middle storey is structural. check_build ok meshClash clear.

lines.label: M3 x 10 socket head screw, ISO 4762
M6 x 20 socket head screw, ISO 4762

notes: Tighten every M6 to 2 N.m: HAND TOOLS ONLY, never a cordless driver. These bolts clamp printed PETG, not metal: at the bolt's own 10.4 N.m rating the head crushes the plastic under it and the joint fails silently, looking tight while holding nothing. Snug, then a nudge. Re-check the bolts after the first few weeks: PETG relaxes under load and the clamp will have eased.
